run_experiment: run an LLVM autotuning experiment across benchmarks using an autotuner and executor
serialize_experiment_to_yaml: serialize an Experiment configuration to a YAML string for inspection or storage
load_experiment_from_logs: reconstruct Experiment objects from previously saved config.json files in a logs directory
get_experiment_dataframe: get experiment results as a pandas DataFrame by concatenating all result CSV files
inspect_experiment_errors: inspect experiment errors as an iterator of dictionaries with benchmark and error details
